AetherEngine and its dependencies (Apple TV and iPhone apps, experimental player engine)
=========================================================================================

The Apple TV and iPhone apps link AetherEngine as an optional, experimental player engine
(Settings > Player > AetherEngine). It is built into the GoatAether framework inside the app,
with none of its optional package traits enabled.

AetherEngine 7.62.1
  https://github.com/superuser404notfound/AetherEngine/tree/7.62.1
  Copyright (C) 2026 Vincent Herbst
  GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0 with an App Store / DRM exception: see
  aetherengine-LICENSE.txt. Used unmodified; the source is at the tag above.

FFmpegBuild 3.14.x (resolved by AetherEngine 7.62.1)
  https://github.com/superuser404notfound/FFmpegBuild
  FFmpeg (libavcodec, libavformat, libavutil, libswresample, libswscale, libavfilter):
  LGPL-2.1-or-later, embedded as dynamic frameworks (AetherLib*.framework).
  dav1d: BSD-2-Clause. zimg: WTFPL. libzvbi: LGPL-2.0-or-later.
  The licence texts are in FFmpegBuild's LICENSES/ folder; the FFmpeg source is linked from
  FFmpegBuild's README.

LibDovi 2.2.x (resolved by AetherEngine 7.62.1)
  https://github.com/superuser404notfound/LibDovi
  libdovi (the dolby_vision crate from dovi_tool, https://github.com/quietvoid/dovi_tool),
  Copyright (c) quietvoid and contributors, used under the MIT licence.
  Packaging and build scripts Copyright (c) 2026 Vincent Herbst, MIT.

SMBClient 0.3.x and LibTrueHD 3.2.x are resolved by the package but not linked: the apps link
only the AetherEngine product (no AetherEngineSMB, no TrueHDObjectAudio trait).
